home.welcomeTitle: Build worlds with vision; tell stories through interaction.
home.intro1: I'm Ashe (Ruohan) Wang, a creator focused on game visual design and interactive storytelling.
home.intro2: From concept design and character development to 3D environment building, I explore how visuals, atmosphere, and game mechanics shape the player experience—worlds worth not only watching, but stepping into.

games.intro: Exploring the intersection of narrative, interaction, and game mechanics to build worlds, shape characters, and evoke emotions through play.

art.intro: A collection of concept art, character design, and 3D environment art, exploring visual styles, atmospheric storytelling, and worldbuilding.

about.heading: Ashe (Ruohan) Wang
about.role: Game Visual Design · Concept Art · 3D Environment Art
about.bio1: I am a visual creator focused on game design and interactive storytelling, with a background in Visual Communication Design from the School of Arts at Renmin University of China.
about.bio2: I am passionate about building immersive experiences through visual design, spatial storytelling, and game mechanics. My work spans game design, concept art, and 3D environment art, while I continue to explore how characters, environments, and narrative can shape the player's emotional experience.
about.bio3: Beyond creating visually compelling imagery, I aspire to build distinctive game worlds with a strong sense of atmosphere, internal logic, and emotional depth.
about.toolsLine: Tools: Unity · Unreal Engine 5 · Maya · ZBrush · Substance 3D Painter · Photoshop
about.focusLine: Areas of Focus: Concept Art · Environment Art · Game Design · Narrative Design
about.contactIntro: For inquiries about my work, creative collaborations, or professional opportunities, feel free to reach out.
